entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE state
entities.description: Radio Resource Control inactive state where UE maintains connection context but is not actively communicating.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE state
entities.description: Radio Resource Control idle state where UE has no active connection.

entities.name: RRC connection resume procedure
entities.description: Procedure to resume an RRC connection from RRC_INACTIVE state.

entities.name: T319a timer
entities.description: Timer used in RRC_INACTIVE state procedures.

entities.name: pendingRNA-Update variable
entities.description: Boolean variable indicating whether an RNA update is pending.

entities.name: RNA Update triggered at SIB1 reception
entities.description: Condition where RNA update is triggered upon receiving System Information Block 1.

entities.name: Barring alleviated for Access Categories
entities.description: Condition where access barring is lifted for Access Category '8' or '2'.

entities.name: No upper layer RRC connection resumption request
entities.description: Condition where upper layers do not request RRC connection resumption.

entities.name: resumeCause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for RRC connection resumption.

entities.name: rna-Update
entities.description: Value for resumeCause indicating RNA update as the reason for resumption.

entities.name: Actions upon going to RRC_IDLE
entities.description: Procedural actions performed when UE transitions to RRC_IDLE state.

relations.description: RNA update triggering condition applies when UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state.
RNA update trigger condition guards initiation of RRC connection resume procedure.
RNA update procedure requires that T319a timer is not running.
RRC connection resume procedure includes resumeCause information element.
resumeCause IE is set to rna-Update value for RNA update procedures.
Access barring alleviation condition guards initiation of RRC connection resume procedure.
Barring alleviation procedure requires no upper layer resumption request.
Barring alleviation procedure requires pendingRNA-Update variable is set to true.
UE in RRC_INACTIVE state performs actions to transition to RRC_IDLE when no suitable cell is found.
Actions upon going to RRC_IDLE result in state transition to RRC_IDLE.
